implementation_rules: Keep each short caption and full disclosure visibly associated with its illustration; do not hide the disclosure only in alt text, a tooltip or a footer.
Use the locale-matched alt and connect the image/figure to its disclosure through aria-describedby; do not replace the meaningful alt with the disclosure paragraph.
Retain the AI label and disclosure in enlarged/zoom views. Original photographs remain available through the adjacent locale-matched link or existing gallery control.

Use these as secondary supporting illustrations, not as a verified close-up or sole source of actual beadwork, embroidery, fabric or product detail. Do not replace or relabel the unchanged original photographs as generated images.
Do not describe either image as restored, exact restoration, unaltered, faithful product detail, background-only edit or crown-only edit. Judge observed regeneration beyond the intended region.
Keep product proper names Blanco Perlado and Rosa Empolvado unchanged in English captions; alt text translates the visual garment description.
No new image generation, image edits, browser use, application-source edits or publication were performed for this contract.
